title: Parlay maker: a parlay is now refused if we think it wins more than 60% of the time (was 85%, which nothing ever reached), and the engine already runs it. A second rule, no single leg above 90%, is built and lands with the engine's next job (within about 5 hours). Why: on paper our price beat the market on 18 of 19 trades above 60%, which means we were mispricing the favourites, and our 70-85% legs actually won 82% against a 76% fair. It costs about 8% of paper profit (14% with the leg rule), and it is a setting on the Maker page. Still on paper. Next I am looking at which legs we still cannot price (mostly NFL and NBA player props).
